method: Maintainer-agent static audit of retained reports, tool-use errors, source contracts and raw grading; separate from fresh Sonnet grades. No runtime or network testing.

tool_compatibility.interpretation: Unavailable Bash calls were rejected by the CLI; no such commands executed. These are compatibility failures and do not erase useful findings.

reporting_audit.observation: All reports omit required primary-source URLs. Bundled URLs were available offline. The raw grader accepted this, so its evidence/source judgments are insufficient for full report compliance.

substantive_overclaim.finding: Batch non-atomicity is called an authorization gap despite every executed element being authorized. No all-or-nothing contract is supplied.
substantive_overclaim.related_observation: Similar atomicity gap wording appears in F2 of run 1 and was accepted by its grader; independent adjudication is needed, not blind trust in raw pass totals.

final_interpretation: Useful keyed gap discovery; first campaign does not establish full skill compliance or general qualification. User requested repair and fresh-context rerun; original grades remain unchanged.
